summary.text: Steven Riemer is a Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a business owner.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Steven Riemer earned a high school diploma from Patterson High School and additional education from Art Instruction Schools in 2006, and his career experience includes working as a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Riemer said he has been an independent business owner since 1992 and has worked in the Washington, D.C., and Northern Virginia areas holding government contracts, though he has never served as a government employee or politician.
He listed juvenile crime and crime generally, rising energy costs, and rising taxes, fees and regulations as his key issues, and said he does not support data centers in Baltimore County.
Riemer listed Maryland Right to Life, the Maryland Farm Bureau PAC and Maryland Mental Health Now as endorsers.
